Callout.Name: Snow Closure - Traffic Inside It
Callout.Message: Road closed by snow fall, traffic unaware.

Script.Line: I did not see a barrier. It is dark and the snow is over it.
There are four of us up here and no way down.
How long is it going to be? I have children in the car.

Lines.Approach: The barrier is up and four vehicles have driven past it. Nobody reads a barrier in the dark.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
